Description: BLS Import Price Index (end use), all commodities, index 2000 = 100
Transformation: Monthly level; signals are growth transforms
Direction Convention: Higher growth = more imported inflation / cost pressure
Known Quirks: Quarterly readings before 1989; monthly since. Recent months revised in the following releases; ALFRED vintages start 2010-03-16; published about mid-month after month end
Display Note: A nominal price index: trending level, so only growth rates are used as signals.
Used as the equity-market target and benchmark.
